market_observations.definition: Average product balance includes corporate USDC and customer USDC in eligible Coinbase products; AOP is period-end customer assets and excludes assets where customers hold full or partial keys.

hypothesis_additions.claim: Circle is diversifying USDC distribution across Coinbase, Binance, SBI and Arc, reducing concentration in any one channel.
hypothesis_additions.counterevidence: Coinbase's Q3 deck claims approximately 50% of USDC economics; Circle's Q2 Coinbase distribution costs were USD655.3M in H1. No current partner-level USDC volume split is available.

hypothesis_additions.claim: Arc may compete with XRPL for institutional stablecoin settlement while coexisting through Circle's multi-chain USDC strategy.
hypothesis_additions.counterevidence: Circle supports native USDC on XRPL; no matched Arc-versus-XRPL payment, FX, liquidity or active-wallet data are available.

hypothesis_additions.claim: Coinbase's USD22B average USDC product balance and USD8.616B period-end USDC AOP measure different populations and time aggregation.
hypothesis_additions.counterevidence: No single reconciliation schedule bridges every balance in the average-products measure to the AOP table; the definitions nevertheless explicitly differ.

hypothesis_additions.claim: Coinbase's aggregate collateral and derivatives infrastructure could create indirect XRP financing or liquidity links.
hypothesis_additions.counterevidence: The filing names BTC and ETH in recognized derivatives collateral; 'other crypto assets' is aggregated and no XRP amount or XRP-specific product is disclosed.

limitations: Circle Q3 2026 results were scheduled for November 4, 2026; Q3 USDC circulation, mint/redemption and reserve-yield figures were not available at this cutoff.
Coinbase's Q3 collateral disclosures do not identify an XRP-specific amount. The aggregate 'other crypto assets' category prevents asserting either zero XRP exposure or a positive XRP balance.
Coinbase's USD22B average product metric and USD8.616B period-end AOP do not have a published line-by-line reconciliation.
Circle's post-June 30, 2026 Circle SBI Japan JV operating results and actual USDC distribution volumes in Japan remain unknown.
Arc public-mainnet transaction volume, active institutional settlement, actual Coinbase/Binance production integration scope and JPYSC live use are not established by the launch release.
SBI Holdings' approximately 9% Ripple stake is historical 2025 evidence; a current October 2026 cap table is unavailable.
Circle Mint mint/redemption figures are customer-initiated primary-market fiat conversions, not all USDC transfers, secondary-market trades or all stablecoin capital flows.
No causal XRP demand, price effect or market-share displacement has been measured from Circle, Coinbase, Binance, SBI or Arc relationships.
interpretation: Circle's network now spans direct USDC distribution relationships with Coinbase, Binance and SBI, while Circle's own Arc public mainnet is a USDC-gas institutional rail and Circle also issues USDC natively on XRPL. This supports a multi-rail interpretation; whether Arc competes with or complements XRPL for actual settlement remains unmeasured. SBI Group's Ripple and Circle interests are separate corporate relationships. SBIC East Japan is not SBI Holdings.
